name: naoj-jupiter-occultations-2019-2020
source_description: NAOJ lunar-occultation prediction form (ephemeris: NAOJ's own). Saved result page for the four Jupiter events of Meeus Table III.
transcription_note: Human-saved NAOJ result pages, transcribed by eye into this small document. NAOJ draws the contact times as a .gif image; OCR of that image is forbidden by the project handoff, so only the machine-readable status text is captured. 'status' is NAOJ's own wording for the event; 'is_visible' is the boolean this project reads from it.
